recommendations: Repository-scale TypeScript/Svelte diagnosis: DeepSeek V4 Flash Go is the current winner; allow roughly four minutes for its deeper first-pass review.
Luna-high is faster to inspect but required a report-only rework; force a no-more-tools finalization step if routed this task class.

Do not route repository-scale TypeScript/Svelte diagnosis to GLM-5.2 by default: after about 8.5 minutes and $0.28159626 it found two confirmed defects but supplied one invalid fix; DeepSeek scored higher at about one-seventh the cost.
Small code-in-prompt diagnosis: DeepSeek V4 Flash Free beat MiMo-V2.5 Free on correctness despite higher latency.
Do not route broad repository archaeology to the tested free DeepSeek or MiMo loops until their read-loop non-completion is controlled.
DeepSeek regional consent is now enabled; use it in the next controlled CV-reproduction comparison.

Qwen 3.8 Max is useful for text-only CV architecture synthesis and corrected both reviewer-identified assumptions cleanly in-session, but its repository-review value was erased here by repeated endpoint failures; do not make it the sole release reviewer until availability improves.
